caption: The drawing depicts an object consisting of a central rectangular section displaying an image of the Virgin of Guadalupe, characterized by a figure with brown hair, clothed in a pink robe with a golden-yellow mantle, and a blue-green cloak with gold stars. The figure stands in front of a radiating gold and orange aura with wavy lines. Surrounding the central image are three sections resembling pieces of silver or gray metal, each studded with rows of small rivets and forming a triptych-like structure with one panel to the left, one to the right, and one arched panel above. The panels have rounded shapes and metallic coloring. Extending from the top of the structure is a brown loop, which appears to be a handle or strap. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, and there is text in the lower right corner reading "Majel G. Claflin - Taos - N.M."
title: Hand Drawn Guadalupe in Tin Form
